description: Run an AML compliance screen on a single blockchain address BEFORE paying or receiving from it — the pre-payment check on a counterparty. Checks OFAC sanctions, known mixers, scam and phishing lists, stablecoin issuer freezes, and on-chain heuristics. Returns a verdict (clear | caution | risky), a 0–100 risk score, a blocked flag, and the matching signals — receipts, not a black-box score. A clear verdict means nothing was found in the data OceanAlt holds; it is not a statement that the address is safe. Depth varies by chain (see coverage.chains at /.well-known/agent-capabilities). Supports EVM (0x…), Tron (T…), Solana (base58). Free, no API key.

address.description: Address to screen. EVM: 0x + 40 hex. Tron: T + 33 base58. Solana: base58 public key.

lang.description: Language for human-readable fields (signals, note, advice). Defaults to English.

network.description: EVM chain (optional; auto-defaults to ethereum; ignored for Tron/Solana).

name: screen_address

reason_code.description: Stable reason code; table at https://oceanalt.com/api/contract.

risk.description: Rounded to 10 when detail_level is coarse.

signal_keys.description: Language-independent keys. Branch on these. Full list at https://oceanalt.com/api/contract.

signals.description: Human-readable. Do not branch on these.

verdict.description: clear means no match in the data held, not that it is safe. uncertain must never be treated as clear.

title: Screen a payee address for AML risk (free)
